crm_record_body:
Account summary
- Helios Health evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for HIPAA-regulated workloads. Strong technical fit, but security/legal gating items are the critical path.
- Primary story angle for reference program: "Private/VPC deployment with audit logs + KMS integrations; reliable inference for regulated workloads." They are open to being a reference for calls; public case study likely anonymized unless legal signs off.

Firmographics
- Industry: Healthcare (provider network + patient engagement platform)
- HQ: US (multi-state); strict US-only data residency requirement
- Size: Enterprise (1000+ employees; large compliance org)

Deal / stage
- Stage: Evaluation
- Target products: Redwood Private (VPC) + optional Optimize (for cost controls / batching recommendations)
- Success criteria (from calls):
  - "No PHI leaves our VPC." (they want this in writing + diagram)
  - Audit logging that covers admin actions + inference access events (who/when/what model) with export capability
  - Clear retention posture + ability to export logs to their SIEM
  - Data residency controls: US region only; avoid silent failover to EU/other regions
  - BAA executed prior to production traffic

Use case details / workloads
- Current workload focus:
  - Clinical note summarization + drafting (provider-facing)
  - Patient message triage + routing
  - Internal RAG on policy/protocol docs (embeddings + reranking under consideration)
- Traffic shape (early estimate): bursty daytime usage; expecting higher Q4 volume due to rollout to additional clinics.
- Latency: wants <2s perceived response for assistant flows; will accept longer for background summarization.

Security / compliance requirements (highlights)
- HIPAA + BAA required (their standard addendum; expects vendor to list subprocessors and flow-down obligations)
- SSO/SAML required for console access; role-based access / least privilege
- Audit logs:
  - Needs to include: authentication events, permission changes, model/config changes, request metadata (no PHI in logs), and admin actions
  - Export: asked for format clarity (JSON/CSV) + delivery method (S3-style bucket, webhook, or scheduled export)
  - Retention: requested 6+ years for compliance investigation workflows; open to Redwood retaining shorter if Helios can export to their system of record (their SIEM)
- KMS / key mgmt:
  - Prefer customer-managed keys, rotation support, and documentation on envelope encryption
- Data residency:
  - "US-only" (processing + storage). They want explicit contractual language: no cross-border processing; failover needs approval.

Key stakeholders / contacts (known)
- Champion: Director of ML Platform (technical driver; pushing for VPC model serving standardization)
- Economic buyer: VP Engineering (needs SLA clarity + total cost)
- InfoSec: Security GRC lead + Security Architect (owns audit log + KMS questions)
- Legal: Commercial counsel + Compliance (HIPAA/BAA owner)
- Procurement: vendor onboarding team (will require SOC 2 package + security questionnaire)

Activity timeline (recent)
- 2025-09-05: Intro + requirements capture; confirmed VPC-only preference; requested security package (SOC 2, subprocessors list, pen test summary).
- 2025-09-18: Technical deep dive with SE; discussed Private control plane, network boundaries, and logging strategy; follow-up questions on export + retention.
- 2025-10-07: Fireflies call (Security + approvals for case study). Key quote: "Ranges are okay; exact numbers are hard to publish. We can’t publish anything that implies PHI handling specifics." (linked: 2025-10-07-helios-health-security-and-approvals-for-case-study)
- 2025-10-08: Legal/compliance email thread with redlines (BAA language + anonymization requests) (linked: 20251008-helios-case-study-legal-and-compliance-review)
- 2025-10-16: Support/Sec clarification requested on audit log export format + what can be stated publicly (Jira SUP-3890 opened).
- 2025-10-23: Internal alignment w/ Marketing + Legal: if public story proceeds, likely anonymized "Top-10 US provider" style; otherwise reference calls only.

Notes (verbatim-ish / paraphrased)
- "Audit logs are table stakes, but we need to be able to pipe them into our SIEM with our retention rules." 
- "We can’t have surprise region failover. If you fail over, we need a control / approval path." 
- "BAA must cover prompts and outputs—our legal team considers both PHI if users paste anything." 

Risks / watch-outs
- They are sensitive to any wording that implies Redwood stores prompts/outputs beyond what is required for operation; require clear statement of retention and controls.
- Public case study risk: likely only after full security approval; may require anonymization and removing metrics.

Open questions
- Confirm whether they will require on-prem option as a long-term fallback (asked once; not a hard requirement yet).
- Clarify acceptable audit log schema (fields they require) and export cadence (near-real-time vs daily batch).

Immediate to-dos
- Provide updated security/architecture write-up focusing on: VPC boundaries, where data flows, what is logged, and how to exclude PHI from logs.
- Align Legal on BAA template path (Redwood baseline vs accepting Helios paper) and provide turnaround timeline.
- If reference program proceeds: lock scope to reference calls first; public case study contingent on anonymization + final approval.
